actions.name: fs_list
actions.description: List directory entries (name/kind/size_bytes/modified_unix_ms) under an allowed root, dirs first then alphabetical; include_hidden shows dotfiles (default false); capped at FILES_PLUGIN_MAX_LIST_ENTRIES (default 1000, sets truncated=true past that). Use fs_read to get a file's contents, not this.

path.description: Absolute directory path inside an allowed root.
Canonical directory path that was listed.

truncated.description: True when the entry count hit FILES_PLUGIN_MAX_LIST_ENTRIES.

actions.name: fs_read
actions.description: Read/open a file's contents as UTF-8 text, falling back to base64 for binary data, a nonzero offset, or a truncated read; offset (default 0) and max_bytes (default FILES_PLUGIN_MAX_READ_BYTES, hard-capped 8 MiB) window the read and truncated=true means EOF wasn't reached. Errors on directories — use fs_list for those.

path.description: Absolute file path inside an allowed root.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from.

max_bytes.description: Read window; defaults to FILES_PLUGIN_MAX_READ_BYTES, hard-capped at 8 MiB.

data.description: File bytes as UTF-8 text, or base64 when the utf8 rule doesn't apply.

truncated.description: True when the read window ended before EOF.

actions.name: fs_write
actions.description: Write or overwrite a file's entire contents from text or content_base64 (exactly one required); create_parents=true (default false) makes missing parent directories. Overwrites the existing file with no backup — refuses to target a directory, a symlink, or an allowed root itself.

path.description: Absolute file path inside an allowed root.

text.description: Content as UTF-8 text. Exactly one of text / content_base64.

content_base64.description: Content as standard base64. Exactly one of text / content_base64.

create_parents.description: Create missing parent directories (inside the sandbox).

path.description: Canonical absolute path that was written.

actions.name: fs_delete
actions.description: Delete a file or directory (recursively) inside an allowed root; to_trash (default true) moves it to the freedesktop Trash instead of permanent removal — set to_trash=false to delete permanently and unrecoverably. Refuses to delete an allowed root itself.

to_trash.description: Move to freedesktop Trash instead of permanent delete.

actions.name: fs_mkdir
actions.description: Create a directory inside an allowed root; parents=true (default false) creates missing intermediate directories (like mkdir -p). Idempotent: succeeds with created=false if the directory already exists; errors if the path exists as a non-directory.

path.description: Absolute directory path inside allowed root.

actions.name: fs_rename
actions.description: Rename/move a file or directory from one path to another within allowed roots; errors if the destination exists unless overwrite=true (default false), which deletes the destination first. Equivalent in effect to fs_move.

from.description: Absolute source path inside allowed root.

to.description: Absolute destination path inside allowed root.

actions.name: fs_move
actions.description: Move a file or directory from one path to another within allowed roots; errors if the destination exists unless overwrite=true (default false), which deletes the destination first. Identical implementation to fs_rename — either name works.

from.description: Absolute source path inside allowed root.

to.description: Absolute destination path inside allowed root.

FILES_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Comma-separated absolute directory paths the plugin may touch. Unset/empty = deny-all.

FILES_PLUGIN_MAX_LIST_ENTRIES.description: Cap on fs_list entries; listings past this are truncated.

FILES_PLUGIN_MAX_READ_BYTES.description: Default fs_read window. Hard-capped at 8388608 (8 MiB).
